caption: The drawing depicts a wooden dresser with three large drawers, each adorned with ornate handles and keyholes. The dresser is colored in shades of brown, suggesting a wood finish, with intricate carved details on the drawer faces and along the edges. On top of the dresser sits a vertical mirror with a rounded top framed by elaborately carved wood, including scroll and floral patterns. The surface of the dresser appears to have a lighter-colored top, possibly indicating a marble surface. The background is plain, off-white, and there are no other objects or decorations present in the composition. The artist's signature is visible in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Dresser with Marble Top
